mcdx_ql 0.1.0

Contents:
  mcdx_ql-0.1.0.crate     — Rust cargo package
  docs/                        — rustdoc HTML (docs/mcdx_ql/index.html)
  java/mcdx-ql-0.1.0.jar  — Java bindings (JNI; native lib embedded)
  java/native/                 — raw native libs (optional)

Rust (sibling private repos):
  mcdx_ql = { git = "https://github.com/nilpferdschaefer/mcdx-ql", tag = "v0.1.0" }

Java:
  // Maven: install the JAR into a private repo, or path-depend in CI
  java -cp java/mcdx-ql-0.1.0.jar com.nilpferdschaefer.mcdxql.SmokeTest

  String json = McdxQl.compile("{\"expr\":\"AVG([close.1d], 14)\",\"assets\":[\"BTC\"],\"params\":{\"period\":14}}");
